design_note: Authored ruleset for the Legality Engine (CSP over splice_rules). This file gates PERMISSION and resolves NON-NUMERIC config (force-intent legality, ingredient/trait-slot assignment, tier-target legality, flags, gate satisfaction). It NEVER computes stats, force blends, entropy, or corruption COSTS — those belong to lab_engine. All flavor lives in 'desc' fields only.

adjacency._note: Non-opposed force relations used only for legality framing. 'same' and 'adjacent' fuse without the abomination flag; 'opposed' (see above) sets it. lab_engine still owns the actual blend math; this is permission framing only.

thresholds._note: Player corruption gates. Data, not code — tunable in the balance sprint. Mirrored to client/domain/constants ONLY as the shared threshold values lab_engine also reads.

unlock_desc.abomination_rites: The blasphemer's license. Lets opposed-force fusion proceed before corruption reaches the natural threshold — you learn to hold two enemies in one body without your hands shaking. The world still notices.
unlock_desc.auto_chirurgy: You stop bringing beasts to the table and bring yourself. Required to run any operation on the player's own character. There is no anaesthetic; there is no going back.
unlock_desc.necromancy: Permission to argue with the recently filed. Rebuild from your Graveyard, or wake a Succession god-snapshot — yours or a friend's. The dead consent to nothing; you do it anyway.
unlock_desc.machine_godhood: The Iron Guild's heresy: a built thing can hold a living core. Unlocks reanimation/graft paths that turn a construct into a living-core candidate. Halix would be so proud.
unlock_desc.deep_communion: What the Deep Choir bartered in secrets, not coin. Sanctions the rare aberrant grafts — eldritch organs on flesh that should have rejected them. The flesh does not reject them. That is the problem.

flags._note: Derived booleans the CSP constrains. lab_engine reads them to know which cost track + world-state hooks to fire. The CSP sets them; it does not price them.

fuse.desc: Two creatures into one chimera. The signature cut. Adjacent or shared forces blend quietly; opposed forces make an abomination and the world goes looking for it.
fuse.force_rule_note: Defers the actual blend (primary 0.6 / secondary 0.4) to lab_engine. The CSP only validates that the requested force_intent is a legal subset of {forces(a) ∪ forces(b)} and decides whether the pairing is compatible or abomination.
fuse.tier_rule_note: tier_target defaults to max(tA, tB). It may exceed that ONLY if a tier-raising core/soul is consumed; lab_engine performs the T1→T2→T3 escalation, the CSP merely permits the ceiling.
illegal_when: force_intent not a subset of inputs' forces
tier_target exceeds max(tA,tB) with no tier-raising core consumed
organic+construct fusion with no bridging part (no hybrid bridge)

mutate.desc: One creature plus a gene-vial or mutagen, modified in place. Cheap, intimate, mostly survivable. Cross-force genes don't kill it — they just make it unstable and a little wrong.
mutate.force_rule_note: The host's force identity is unchanged by mutate; lab_engine surfaces the gene's stat/trait. The CSP only checks the gene is legal on the host's force/class, or flags the cross-force case.

taboo_when.note: Cross-force gene = 'taboo-lite': lab_engine applies an entropy spike rather than full abomination cost. Same gate as fuse-abomination but the consequence is the creature's instability, not a world bounty.

illegal_when: gene class incompatible with host class (e.g. construct-only gene on organic with no hybrid bridge)
two mutually-exclusive genes in the same lineage slot

graft.desc: Augment a living beast with an organ, plating, or core. The everyday surgery — until the organ on your table used to belong to a god.
graft.force_rule_note: Grafting does not re-blend the host's forces; lab_engine attaches the organ's trait. The CSP checks organ↔force/class legality and slot occupancy/conflict.

taboo_when.note: God-tier organ/core (e.g. Hades' Marrow, a God-Soul Ingot). Needs BOTH the divine part in hand AND corruption ≥ T_god. lab_engine then applies god-tier power + heavy corruption cost.

illegal_when: organ force/class not legal on host (ingredient_compat fails) and no hybrid bridge present
two organs claim the same trait_slot (slot conflict)
core count exceeds the slot max (core slot is 0..1)
construct-only part on organic host with no bridging part

self_splice.desc: You stop operating on beasts and start operating on yourself. The chimera-god route, done by your own hand. Always gated; there was never a version of this that was safe.
self_splice.force_rule_note: lab_engine resolves which force-power the player gains (e.g. Deathtouch from a Thanatos god-organ) and the corruption cost. The CSP only confirms the operation is permitted at all and the part is legal on a player vessel.

taboo_when.note: Requires corruption ≥ T_self AND the auto_chirurgy unlock, ALWAYS — there is no legal self-splice without both. lab_engine writes the corruption onto the player and may lock the Pure ending / turn the world hostile.

illegal_when: part not legal on a player vessel (ingredient_compat 'player' class absent)

reanimate.desc: Rebuild from the Graveyard, or wake a Succession god-snapshot — yours or a friend's. Necromancy of the dead, and of other people's dead gods. Souls are mandatory; the dead are not consulted.
reanimate.force_rule_note: The reanimated subject keeps the dead creature's / snapshot's force identity; lab_engine reconstitutes the stat-spine from the stored lineage. The CSP confirms a soul/core is present and the necromancy unlock is held.

friend_snapshot_extra.note: Waking a FRIEND'S async Succession god is the necromancy-of-friends'-gods case: lab_engine tags lineage with the source player + may escalate corruption. The CSP records it as contraband-flagged so the world-state hook fires.

taboo_when.note: Necromancy ALWAYS needs the unlock AND a soul/core. A god_snapshot input additionally trips god_graft + world_bounty; a friend's snapshot also trips contraband.

illegal_when: input is neither a graveyard part nor a god_snapshot

trait_slots._note: Body slots an organ/graft can occupy. The CSP assigns each provided organ to a legal slot; two organs claiming the same slot (beyond 'max') is a conflict → backtrack. 'accepts' lists organ archetype keys (see ingredient_compat 'slot'). Whole-creature stat math is still lab_engine's; these slots govern PLACEMENT legality only.

head.desc: Skull, sensory crown, what's left of the face.

eyes.desc: Ocular cluster. More eyes is rarely an improvement to look at, often an improvement to be.

core.desc: The chest cavity — heart, soul, reactor. One beating want per body; the engine refuses a second.

endocrine.desc: Glands and the chemistry of bad decisions. Adrenal, venom, bile.

forelimbs.desc: Arms, claws, the grasping front. Paired by convention, not by law.

hindlimbs.desc: Legs, the running back. Lose these and you become someone's ambush, not their pursuer.

tail.desc: The afterthought that does most of the steering. Or the stinging.

hide.desc: Skin, scale, carapace, plating. The boundary between the beast and the world, negotiable.

wings.desc: What lets a thing arrive from a direction you weren't watching.

aura.desc: The non-anatomical slot — the field a creature projects. Glyph, ward, miasma, charm. One presence per body; auras do not layer.

marrow.desc: What's in the bones — the deep slot. Where divine grafts root, and where they're hardest to remove later.

frame.desc: Construct-only: the structural chassis. Beams, struts, the skeleton you bolted together. Organic bodies have no frame slot.

ingredient_compat._note: The legality library: which forces + classes each ingredient is legal on. 'slot' maps the ingredient to its trait_slot archetype. Keys are clean; flavor in 'desc'. An ingredient is grafTable on a host only if the host shares one of the listed 'forces' (or the rule is 'any') AND the host class is in 'class'. 'rank' gates god-tier taboo. This table NEVER carries stat values — lab_engine reads the trait the part grants.

gravetusk_adrenal_gland.desc: Boar-line adrenal. Pump it in and 'stop' becomes a foreign concept. Grants a charge-Strike on graft.

gloamcat_soul_bladder.desc: Still leaking the colour of dusk. Grants a lifesteal Drain; the host arrives last and leaves first.

augurwing_foresight_eye.desc: An eye that already saw this coming. Grants an evade/foresight read.

sigil_antler_ward.desc: Antler etched in old protective glyphs. Grants a Ward-tint barrier on graft.

worldback_tooth.desc: A tooth from something that carried a hill on its back. Grants a Bulk-anchor stagger-resist.

emberwyrm_cinder_heart.desc: A coal that never went out. Grants a Spike burst; the host smells faintly of the last thing it burned.

palehart_vitae_node.desc: A node that keeps pumping after the heart's given up. Grants a Vitality regen.

quagsovereign_bile_sac.desc: A sac of swamp-end. Grants a Bane corrosion-on-hit.

tunnelward_carapace.desc: Plates grown by a thing that lives where the ceiling can fall. Grants a Ward/Bulk hide.

khamsoon_galeclaw.desc: A talon honed by a desert that never stops moving. Grants a Celerity opener.

constellute_starcrest.desc: A crest that holds a little fixed light. Grants a Ward/Celerity control read.

leviathan_deepgill.desc: Gills that breathe the pressure of the trench. Grants a Bulk/Bane sustain underwater and elsewhere.

reveler_charm_glands.desc: Glands that make a thing easy to love and easier to forgive. Grants a charm-field aura.

stoneblooded_horn.desc: Clan-bred horn, hand-warm. Grants a Bulk ram-Strike.

stormvault_winglash.desc: A wing-membrane that still crackles. Grants a Celerity reposition.

dustdervish_stinger.desc: A barb wrapped in stinging grit. Grants a Spike/Bane poke.

mournmarch_grave_pelt.desc: A pelt that remembers being buried. Grants a Bane decay-aura hide.

bloomwarden_thornlash.desc: A whip of fast-growing thorn. Grants a Vitality/Bulk lash.

deep_choir_lure_node.desc: An anglerfish lantern that sings. Aberrant — legal only with deep_communion. Grants a control miasma.

hades_marrow.desc: A bone the death-god won't miss for a while. Grants Deathtouch-adjacent Drain at divine scale. Taboo on a mortal beast; the Pantheon marks you.

hephaestus_coal_heart.desc: Still forging something. Turns a built thing into a living-core candidate — the machine-godhood route.

aphrodite_unspent_heartbeat.desc: A pulse the Primordial never used. Every creature you raise loves you a little before it has reason to. Disquieting. Effective. Player-graftable.

uranus_skyshard_eye.desc: A splinter of the first sky's sight. Grants Celerity-precognition at divine scale.

gaia_worldseed_node.desc: A seed with a continent folded inside. Grants Bulk-regeneration at divine scale.

chaos_unmade_shard.desc: A piece of the thing before things. Grants Spike that ignores the rules it was told. Reads as Chaos to everything that fears it.

cosmos_lawgivers_sigil.desc: A glyph that says NO to the world and means it. Grants a Ward at divine scale; pairs into machine-gods of pure Cosmos.

vial_dominant_bulk.desc: Bottled stubbornness. Surfaces a Bulk gene; the lineage gets heavier with implication.

vial_recessive_celerity.desc: A speed that runs in the family but hides. Surfaces Celerity; offspring outpaces its parents and its luck.

vial_recessive_bane.desc: The mean gene grandmother never discussed. Surfaces Bane; the bloodline's bite gets ideas.

vial_wild_spike.desc: Will not be told what to express. High Spike, high variance, faint smell of ozone and regret.

vial_dominant_ward.desc: A gene that flinches first so the body doesn't have to. Surfaces Ward.

vial_recessive_vitality.desc: The gene for outliving the prognosis. Surfaces Vitality, quietly.

vial_pure_pole_concentrate.desc: One force, undiluted, screaming to express. Pushes a lineage toward a pole — the breeder's Apotheosis fuel.
vial_pure_pole_concentrate.note: Legal on a host only if it shares the chosen single pole; never legal as a cross-force gene without tripping mutate's taboo_lite.

common_mutagen_draught.desc: Generic instability in a bottle. Surfaces a random in-force trait; the cheap door into mutation.

cracked_anima_cell.desc: A soul with a hairline fault, sold cheap and humming. Powers minor Builds and routine rituals. Can raise a tier once.

bound_spirit_battery.desc: Someone's afterlife on a leash. Steady ritual fuel; contraband, draws heat.

legendary_heartcore.desc: The still-beating want of something that was nearly a god. Powers ascension-grade rituals; raises a tier.

god_soul_ingot.desc: Distilled godhood, poured into a bar you can hold but shouldn't. The keystone fuel of your own Apotheosis. God-rank — trips the god gate.

succession_snapshot_core.desc: A hot core carrying a dead god's whole self — yours or a friend's. The reanimation keystone; soul mandatory, conscience optional.

dead_automaton_scrap.desc: Forgefell's endless harvest. Bulk filler for any Build; somebody's masterwork, by weight.

sigil_etched_plating.desc: Salvage that still remembers being a wall. Adds Ward-tint to a construct; sold by the crate.

adamant_frame_beam.desc: A beam that has never once bent and resents being asked. Structural Bulk for a construct frame.

stormvault_conductor_wire.desc: Wire that carries a charge it didn't ask to hold. Adds Celerity-tint to a construct.

havoc_riot_plate.desc: Plating that was an explosion once and remembers fondly. Adds Spike-tint to a construct.

iron_throne_carapace_panel.desc: A panel off something that called itself a throne. Premium Ward/Bulk chassis; the law, by the crate.

opposed_force_solvent.desc: Contraband that lets two enemies share one body without the body voting on it. Eases the opposed-fusion gate; always premium, always heat.

hybrid_bridge_graftplasm.desc: Grey jelly that convinces meat and metal they were always related. The bridging part: the only thing that lets organic + construct become hybrid.

sextons_consecrated_marrow_kit.desc: For exhuming what you buried and improving it. Lowers the sanity cost of reanimating your own Graveyard; routes more through the soul instead. Necromancy aid.

csp_contract._note: How the rules drive godot-constraint-solving. Declarative; the solver does backtracking search. Stat/blend/cost computation is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE here.

domains.force_intent: legal subset of union(forces(a), forces(b)) for fuse; host force otherwise
domains.tier_target: max(tA,tB) .. ceiling, where ceiling rises only if a tier_raise core/soul is consumed
domains.class_target: {organic, construct, hybrid}; hybrid only with a hybrid_bridge part
domains.trait_slots[i]: compatible organs from provided ingredients, by trait_slots.accepts

constraints: force_compatibility: same/shared/non-opposed = ok; opposed sets flags.taboo+abomination and requires the gate
ingredient_legality: organ/gene occupies a slot only if host shares a listed force (or 'any') AND host class in ingredient.class
slot_exclusivity: no two organs in the same trait_slot beyond its 'max'; respect class_restricted slots
gene_exclusivity: no two mutually-exclusive genes in the same lineage slot
tier_ceiling: tier_target <= max(tA,tB) unless a tier_raise core/soul is consumed
class_rules: construct output requires plating/core; organic+construct requires a hybrid_bridge to become hybrid
gate_satisfaction: every flag requiring a taboo gate must have its precondition met (corruption / unlock / specific part); else reject the assignment
unlock_required_parts: ingredients with requires_unlock are legal only if that unlock is held

results.LEGAL: a consistent assignment exists and no gate fails → emit splice_config
results.TABOO: a consistent assignment exists but needs an unmet gate → return unlock/corruption cost so the UI can offer it
results.ILLEGAL: no consistent assignment → return the specific failing constraint (dread microcopy)

csp_contract.choice_among_legal_variants: if multiple assignments satisfy all constraints, pick one with canonical_rng(run.seed, op_id); persist the chosen splice_config in creature_instances.lineage.splice_config
